title: Wix Migration
meta: Move your site to Wix from WordPress, Squarespace or others, with pages, images and redirects carried over. From $200, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Wix migration with content and redirects kept
overview: We move your existing website onto Wix so you can manage it in one simple editor. Pages, text, images and blog posts are copied over and laid out to match your old design or a cleaner version of it. We add redirects for old addresses, check forms and links, and connect your domain only when you approve. Your old site stays live until the new one is ready.

faq: Which platforms can I move from?
WordPress, Squarespace, Weebly, GoDaddy, Webflow and hand-coded sites are common. Send the link and we check what can be copied automatically and what we rebuild by hand.
Can you move my online store to Wix?
Yes, for small catalogs, as an add-on that moves up to 25 products with images. Larger stores with customer and order history are a bigger job that we quote separately.
A short dip after any move is normal. We reduce the risk by keeping page addresses where we can, redirecting every changed one and copying titles and descriptions. We cannot promise rankings.
Does my old site stop working?
Only when you decide. We build the new site on a Wix address first. When you approve, we point your domain to Wix and you cancel the old hosting yourself.
